'''Security sweepers''' were devices used by government officials and military personnel to guard against espionage. They had been designed to detect hidden [[recorder]]s and listening devices by identifying specialized electronic components, while ignoring common tools like [[Holocamera/Legends|holocams]] or [[Datapad/Legends|datapads]]. Although sweepers had accurately pinpointed the location of surveillance equipment, they typically were not able to determine the precise function of the detected devices.<ref name="Desperate Allies" />

==Behind the scenes==
Security sweepers were mentioned in ''[[Desperate Allies]]'', a [[Roleplaying game|roleplaying]] supplementary sourcebook for the ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying]]'' series that was published by [[Fantasy Flight Games]] in [[2015]].<ref name="Desperate Allies" />
